font.usage: Wordmark 500; BY SINGLETON SD caps line 600. Rasterizer must load these files and must not fall back to a system font.

tokens.note: Authoritative semantic ids for product yellows/grays. SVG masters keep baked hex and do not import the package at runtime. LeaseMate uses only Singleton gold/yellow, black, white and grays — no product accent.

yellowDark500.usage: primary mark on dark / black backgrounds

yellowLight500.usage: primary mark on light / white backgrounds

gray500.usage: rooms on dark; BY SINGLETON SD caps; dark gray bar
gray500.note: Legacy camelCase key gray500; hex matches tokens gray-600, not gray-500 (#9DA1A6).

gray300.usage: muted gray accents on light themes (core Singleton token; not used in the mark itself)

grayLight500.usage: rooms on light; light gray bar

ui.note: Never use gold as text on white. Focus is gray-900 (design-system tokens).

designSource: LeaseMate brand overlay — house icon (56-unit grid) + Open Sauce Sans lockup, Singleton gold/black only
